name: UQ Union Student Advocacy and Support (free solicitor and Centrelink help)
summary: Free, independent UQ Union service with a solicitor plus help with Centrelink, finances, tenancy and other welfare matters.
who: Currently enrolled UQ undergraduate and postgraduate students.
how: Book an appointment through the UQU SAS booking portal.
catches: Legal topics include residential tenancy, consumer complaints, civil disputes and family law.

source.label: UQ Union: Student Advocacy and Support

evidence.quote: SAS is a free, independent hub of support for you
SAS can help, with our solicitor ready to assist you.
Only currently enrolled UQ undergraduate and postgraduate students are eligible for this service.
